LiHua extended an invitation to Chae to join Wolfgang and Yuriko for music jam sessions every Sunday night. This social gathering is centered around playing music together, and LiHua believes that Chae's bass skills would be a valuable addition to the group. The jam sessions typically start around 8 pm, with the group playing their favorite songs and exploring new ones together. LiHua expressed enthusiasm for Chae joining them and looked forward to adding Chae's unique contribution to the group's musical dynamics.
